description: A null if condition is an error even when the collection is empty
notes: The spec says the if condition is evaluated once for each source element, so with an empty collection it is never evaluated and the result is an empty tuple. hashicorp/hcl first evaluates the condition once with the key and value variables set to unknown values, and returns a null condition error from that check even when there are no elements (ForExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
